rationale: iter-42: GroupNorm -> BatchNorm on iter-32 baseline. Headroom 0.5906 -> 0.5889 (-0.18pp, smallest discard yet). At batch_size=1 BN reduces to per-instance affine, so the change is essentially semantic — it loses the cross-channel-group normalisation but adds learnable affine. The tiny regression suggests GroupNorm is the right norm; BN is not horribly wrong but not better. Discard, revert.
advice_for_others: GroupNorm > BatchNorm on the alpha-scaling residual stack at batch_size=1 (regression -0.18pp). The cross-channel-group statistics in GN provide effective regularisation at small data that BNs per-instance behaviour cannot match.
